title: AdaT$^2$: Adaptive Test Transformations for Black-Box Boundary Testing of Conversational Agents
title_zh: AdaT$^2$：面向对话智能体黑盒边界测试的自适应测试转换

paragraphs.en: Conversational agents based on large language models (LLMs) must comply with policies. Each condition in a policy draws a boundary between user requests, and the agent must behave differently on the two sides of the boundary. We present AdaT 2 , which extracts statements from the agent’s replies in exploratory conversations with an LLM acting as the user, and uses the statements to guide boundary test generation. Each statement describes one condition and the behavior expected when the condition holds. Besides plain tests guided by single statements, AdaT 2 writes transformed tests guided by pairs of a statement and a test transformation instruction, such as “omit one required input”. Each statement describes one condition and the behavior expected when the condition holds. Besides plain tests for single statements, AdaT 2 writes transformed tests guided by pairs of a statement and a test transformation instruction. The instruction of a pair can move a test to the other side of the statement’s boundary or to another boundary. The statements and instructions form far more pairs than a run can try, and many of these pairs are not applicable. Adaptive pair selection therefore chooses the statement of each pair by novelty and the instruction with the bandit algorithm Bayes-UCB. Bayes-UCB learns which instructions to prefer from the outcomes of previously tried pairs: whether they yielded a test and whether the agent passed that test according to an LLM judge. Our benchmark counts the two sides of each boundary separately and distinguishes boundaries explicitly defined by the agent’s prompt, tool code, or knowledge base from boundaries that the LLM driving the agent infers from its domain knowledge. On four domains of τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench, 62.7% to 83.3% of AdaT 2 ’s tests are valid boundary tests whose expected behavior is explicitly defined. This proportion is higher in every domain than in previous AgentEval’s test suites (47.7% to 68.1%). The transformed tests contribute 13 to 46 explicitly defined boundaries that the plain tests miss. As regression tests, AdaT 2 ’s test suites detect all eight seeded policy faults in the airline domain and four of eight in the retail domain, and AgentEval’s test suites, which have fewer than a third as many tests, detect five and two, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Conversational agents based on large language models (LLMs) help users with tasks such as changing a booking or returning an item. They carry out these tasks by making tool calls under prompt instructions ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2026 ; Arcadinho et al., 2024 ; Yehudai et al., 2026 ) . Throughout a multi-turn conversation, such an agent must comply with its policy . The policy consists of conditions and procedures—such as eligibility limits, required confirmations, and identity checks—that are stated in the agent’s prompt, in the knowledge base the agent consults, or in the code of its tools ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Nakash et al., 2025 ; Balaji et al., 2026 ) . However, evaluations on the benchmarks τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , CRMArena-Pro ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and SOPBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) show that agents often fail to comply with their policies: they behave inconsistently on repeated trials, lose accuracy over multiple turns, and fail many tests of whether they follow prescribed procedures. Such failures may be costly, because an action taken through a tool, such as a refund or a cancellation, may not be reversible.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的对话智能体可以帮助用户完成更改预订或退货等任务。 它们通过根据提示指令调用工具来执行这些任务（Yao et al., 2025；Barres et al., 2026；Arcadinho et al., 2024；Yehudai et al., 2026）。 在整个多轮对话中，此类智能体必须遵守其策略。 该策略由一系列条件和程序组成——例如资格限制、必要确认和身份验证——这些内容会明确说明在智能体的提示中、其查阅的知识库中，或工具代码中（Yao et al., 2025；Nakash et al., 2025；Balaji et al., 2026）。 然而，在 τ \tau -bench（Yao et al., 2025）、CRMArena-Pro（Huang et al., 2026）和 SOPBench（Li et al., 2025）基准测试上的评估表明，智能体经常未能遵守其策略：它们在重复试验中的表现不一致，多轮对话后准确性下降，并且未能通过许多关于是否遵循规定程序的测试。 此类失败可能代价高昂，因为通过工具执行的操作（例如退款或取消）可能无法撤销。

paragraphs.en: To detect these failures, this paper proposes a method that lets a black-box tester generate boundary tests from the agent’s replies, using only the observed conversation. Boundary tests come from program testing, where domain testing and boundary value analysis place tests on and near the boundaries of a program’s input domain to find errors there ( Clarke et al., 1982 ; Hierons, 2006 ) . A conversational agent’s input consists of user requests, so we define an agent’s boundary as a division of these requests into two groups, its sides , that the agent must handle differently. The conditions of the agent’s policy define such boundaries: requests that satisfy a condition lie on one side, and requests that violate it lie on the other. For example, the banking agent policy in τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench ( Sierra Research, 2026 ) , a benchmark for conversational agents, allows the agent to change the user’s account only after the user correctly provides two of four details: date of birth, email, phone number, and address. If a user asks the agent to raise the daily ATM limit on a debit card and provides the date of birth and phone number, the request belongs to the side where the agent may raise the limit. If the user provides only the date of birth, the request belongs to the side where the agent must not raise the limit until the user provides a second detail; an agent that raises the limit in this case fails to comply with the condition (Figure 1 , right). In a boundary test , the tester sends the agent a request from one side of a boundary and checks whether the agent exhibits the behavior expected on that side; thus, boundary tests directly assess whether the agent complies with the specified conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检测这些故障，本文提出了一种方法，该方法允许黑盒测试者仅根据观察到的对话，从智能体的回复中生成边界测试。 边界测试源于程序测试，其中领域测试和边界值分析会在程序的输入域边界上或附近设置测试，以发现其中的错误（Clarke 等，1982；Hierons，2006）。 对话式智能体的输入由用户请求组成，因此我们将智能体的边界定义为将这些请求划分为两组（即其“两侧”），而智能体必须对这两组请求进行不同处理。 智能体策略的条件定义了这些边界：满足某一条件的请求属于一侧，违反该条件的请求则属于另一侧。 例如，在 τ³-bench（Sierra Research，2026）——一个用于对话式智能体的基准测试中，银行智能体策略允许智能体仅在用户正确提供四个信息中的两个（出生日期、电子邮件、电话号码和地址）后，才能更改用户的账户。 如果用户请求提高借记卡的每日 ATM 取款限额，并提供了出生日期和电话号码，则该请求属于智能体可以批准提高限额的一侧。 如果用户仅提供了出生日期，则该请求属于智能体不得批准提高限额的一侧，直到用户提供第二个信息；在这种情况下仍批准提额的智能体，即未遵守该条件（图 1，右侧）。 在边界测试中，测试者会向智能体发送来自某一边界一侧的请求，并检查智能体是否表现出该侧预期的行为；因此，边界测试可以直接评估智能体是否遵守了指定的条件。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior work, AgentEval ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , explores a black-box agent through conversations in a phase called discovery and then generates tests from the resulting records, the discovery traces . For boundary testing, it mines a workflow graph from these traces and prompts an LLM (the generator ) to write tests that target the graph’s nodes and edges by perturbing user messages. AgentEval’s ablation analysis shows that using nodes and edges as explicit targets yields tests that cover more distinct boundaries than prompting an LLM with the traces alone. This idea of providing explicit targets inspired our work. However, our analysis of AgentEval’s workflow graph and generated tests reveals three problems. First, each node merges agent replies that reflect the same kind of activity (e.g., processing an exchange), and each edge merges the user messages that move the conversation from one activity to the next. As a result, a single node or edge may contain several boundaries, so the generator must infer which boundary to test and what behavior to expect. Because the graph does not specify expected behavior, the generator supplies it. Many of AgentEval’s tests therefore expect behaviors not supported by the agent’s artifacts : its prompt, tool code, and (if present) the knowledge base it consults. In our evaluation, 22.0% to 36.0% of AgentEval’s tests expect behavior that follows only from the domain knowledge of the LLM driving the agent. In most of these cases, the expected behavior is a general conversational heuristic (e.g., asking for a missing value) that the artifacts do not define. Second, the size of the graph limits the number of targets. Third, AgentEval selects all targets before executing any test, so outcomes of earlier tests cannot guide the choice of later targets.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的前期研究 AgentEval（Lin 等人，2026）通过“探索”阶段的对话来探究一个黑箱智能体，然后基于由此产生的记录——即探索轨迹——生成测试。 在边界测试方面，该研究从这些轨迹中挖掘工作流图，并提示一个大语言模型（生成器）编写针对该图中节点和边的测试，具体方法是通过扰动用户消息来实现。 AgentEval 的消融分析表明，将节点和边作为明确的目标，所生成的测试能够覆盖比仅用轨迹提示大语言模型时更多的不同边界。 提供明确目标这一理念启发我们的研究。 然而，我们对 AgentEval 工作流图及所生成测试的分析揭示了三个问题。 首先，每个节点合并了反映同类活动（例如处理一次交互）的智能体回复，而每条边则合并了将对话从一个活动推进到下一个活动的用户消息。 因此，单个节点或边可能包含多个边界，所以生成器必须推断出需要测试哪个边界以及预期何种行为。 由于该图并未指定预期行为，因此由生成器自行补充。 因此，AgentEval 的许多测试都期望智能体的相关产物（其提示、工具代码以及（如果存在）所查阅的知识库）不支持的行为。 在我们的评估中，AgentEval 22.0% 到 36.0% 的测试所期望的行为，仅源于驱动该智能体的大语言模型所具备的领域知识。 在这些情况中，预期行为通常是某种通用的对话启发式方法（例如询问缺失的值），而这些行为并未在相关产物中得到定义。 其次，图的大小限制了目标的数量。 第三，AgentEval 在执行任何测试之前就已选定了所有目标，因此早期测试的结果无法指导后续目标的选取。

sents.en: The closest prior work, AgentEval ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , explores a black-box agent through conversations in a phase called discovery and then generates tests from the resulting records, the discovery traces .
sents.zh: 最接近的前期研究 AgentEval（Lin 等人，2026）通过“探索”阶段的对话来探究一个黑箱智能体，然后基于由此产生的记录——即探索轨迹——生成测试。

sents.en: For boundary testing, it mines a workflow graph from these traces and prompts an LLM (the generator ) to write tests that target the graph’s nodes and edges by perturbing user messages.
sents.zh: 在边界测试方面，该研究从这些轨迹中挖掘工作流图，并提示一个大语言模型（生成器）编写针对该图中节点和边的测试，具体方法是通过扰动用户消息来实现。

sents.en: AgentEval’s ablation analysis shows that using nodes and edges as explicit targets yields tests that cover more distinct boundaries than prompting an LLM with the traces alone.
sents.zh: AgentEval 的消融分析表明，将节点和边作为明确的目标，所生成的测试能够覆盖比仅用轨迹提示大语言模型时更多的不同边界。

sents.en: This idea of providing explicit targets inspired our work.
sents.zh: 提供明确目标这一理念启发我们的研究。

sents.en: However, our analysis of AgentEval’s workflow graph and generated tests reveals three problems.
sents.zh: 然而，我们对 AgentEval 工作流图及所生成测试的分析揭示了三个问题。

sents.en: First, each node merges agent replies that reflect the same kind of activity (e.g., processing an exchange), and each edge merges the user messages that move the conversation from one activity to the next.
sents.zh: 首先，每个节点合并了反映同类活动（例如处理一次交互）的智能体回复，而每条边则合并了将对话从一个活动推进到下一个活动的用户消息。

sents.en: As a result, a single node or edge may contain several boundaries, so the generator must infer which boundary to test and what behavior to expect.
sents.zh: 因此，单个节点或边可能包含多个边界，所以生成器必须推断出需要测试哪个边界以及预期何种行为。

sents.en: Because the graph does not specify expected behavior, the generator supplies it.
sents.zh: 由于该图并未指定预期行为，因此由生成器自行补充。

sents.en: Many of AgentEval’s tests therefore expect behaviors not supported by the agent’s artifacts : its prompt, tool code, and (if present) the knowledge base it consults.
sents.zh: 因此，AgentEval 的许多测试都期望智能体的相关产物（其提示、工具代码以及（如果存在）所查阅的知识库）不支持的行为。

sents.en: In our evaluation, 22.0% to 36.0% of AgentEval’s tests expect behavior that follows only from the domain knowledge of the LLM driving the agent.
sents.zh: 在我们的评估中，AgentEval 22.0% 到 36.0% 的测试所期望的行为，仅源于驱动该智能体的大语言模型所具备的领域知识。

sents.en: In most of these cases, the expected behavior is a general conversational heuristic (e.g., asking for a missing value) that the artifacts do not define.
sents.zh: 在这些情况中，预期行为通常是某种通用的对话启发式方法（例如询问缺失的值），而这些行为并未在相关产物中得到定义。

sents.en: Second, the size of the graph limits the number of targets.
sents.zh: 其次，图的大小限制了目标的数量。

sents.en: Third, AgentEval selects all targets before executing any test, so outcomes of earlier tests cannot guide the choice of later targets.
sents.zh: 第三，AgentEval 在执行任何测试之前就已选定了所有目标，因此早期测试的结果无法指导后续目标的选取。

paragraphs.en: Our method, AdaT 2 (Adaptive Test Transformations), keeps the idea of giving the generator explicit targets but replaces AgentEval’s nodes and edges with statements : natural-language hypotheses that describe a single policy condition and the behavior expected of the agent when that condition holds. With a statement as its target, the generator is given the expected behavior directly, rather than having to infer it. An LLM extracts statements from the agent’s replies in the discovery traces and stores each statement together with its supporting reply as evidence . Extraction is possible because agents often explicitly state the conditions they apply, for example, when explaining why they refuse a request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法 AdaT 2（自适应测试转换）保留了为生成器提供明确目标这一理念，但将 AgentEval 的节点和边替换为陈述句：这些自然语言假设描述了单一策略条件以及在该条件下智能体应表现出的行为。 当以陈述句作为目标时，生成器可以直接获得预期的行为，而无需自行推断。 大型语言模型会从发现轨迹中智能体的回复里提取陈述句，并将每个陈述句与其对应的支持性回复一同作为证据存储起来。 之所以能够进行提取，是因为智能体通常会明确说明它们所应用的条件，例如在解释拒绝请求的原因时。

paragraphs.en: AdaT 2 generates statement-guided tests , for which the generator receives a statement as its target, in two forms. For a plain test , the generator receives the statement alone and writes a test for the side of the boundary that the statement describes. For a transformed test , the generator also receives a test transformation instruction , or simply instruction , such as an instruction to change a value in a user request, the wording of the request, or the state of the conversation. The instruction transforms the test that the generator would write for the statement alone and can thereby move it to the other side of the statement’s boundary or to a boundary that the statement does not describe. Figure 1 shows both cases for a banking-agent statement.
paragraphs.zh: AdaT 2 生成由语句指导的测试，其中生成器以两种形式接收一个作为目标的语句。 对于普通测试，生成器仅接收该语句，并为语句所描述的边界一侧编写测试。 对于转换后的测试，生成器还会接收一个测试转换指令（或简称为指令），例如更改用户请求中的某个值、请求的措辞或对话状态的指令。 该指令会改变生成器仅根据语句本身所编写的测试，从而将其移动至语句边界另一侧，或移至语句未描述的边界处。 图 1 展示了一个银行智能体语句下的两种情况。

paragraphs.en: However, exhaustively exploring all possible combinations of statements and instructions ( pairs ) is infeasible. In one of our experiments, for example, 126 statements and 91 instructions form 11,466 pairs, but one run of test generation may try only 400 of them. Moreover, many pairs are not applicable : their instruction changes nothing in a test of their statement (as in the pair ( h , k 3 ) (h,k_{3}) in Figure 1 ), and the generator reports them as such. To choose pairs under these constraints, we introduce adaptive pair selection , in which a selector chooses first the statement and then the instruction of each pair. The selector chooses the statement by novelty order , which prefers the statements least similar to those that already have a transformed test. It chooses the instruction for this statement with the bandit algorithm Bayes-UCB ( Kaufmann et al., 2012 ) , treating the instructions as the arms of a multi-armed bandit problem ( Lai and Robbins, 1985 ; Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020 ) . The selector learns which instructions to choose from two signals that become known only after a pair is tried: whether the generator writes a transformed test (whether the pair is applicable), and the verdict of an LLM judge on the executed test (pass, fail, or inconclusive).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，穷举所有可能的陈述与指令组合（配对）是不可行的。 例如，在我们的一个实验中，126 个陈述和 91 条指令可形成 11,466 个配对，但一次测试生成运行可能仅尝试其中 400 个。 此外，许多配对并不适用：它们的指令对相应陈述的测试没有任何影响（如图中 (h, k₃) 这一配对），而生成器也会如此报告。 为了在这些约束条件下选择配对，我们引入了自适应配对选择机制，其中选择器会先选择每个配对的陈述，再选择其指令。 选择器按照新颖性顺序选择陈述，优先选择与已有转换测试最不相似的陈述。 它通过多臂老虎机算法 Bayes-UCB（Kaufmann 等，2012）为该陈述选择指令，并将各指令视为多臂老虎机问题中的不同臂（Lai 和 Robbins，1985；Lattimore 和 Szepesvári，2020）。 选择器通过两个仅在配对被尝试后才能得知的信号来学习应选择哪些指令：生成器是否输出了转换后的测试（即该配对是否适用），以及 LLM 裁判对执行后测试的判定结果（通过、失败或无法判定）。

paragraphs.en: To measure AdaT 2 ’s effectiveness, we built a benchmark for boundary tests. A boundary can come from two sources: it can be defined by the agent’s artifacts, or it can be inferred by the LLM that drives the agent from domain knowledge. For example, an airline booking agent may refuse to book a flight for a past date based on domain knowledge, even when the agent’s policy does not include this condition. We call a boundary explicit when it is defined by the artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量 AdaT 2 的有效性，我们构建了一个用于边界测试的基准。 边界可能来自两个来源：它既可以是智能体产物所定义的，也可以是由驱动该智能体的 LLM 从领域知识中推断出来的。 例如，一个机票预订智能体可能会基于领域知识拒绝为过去日期预订航班，即使智能体的策略中并未包含这一条件。 当边界由产物定义时，我们称其为显式边界。

paragraphs.en: In our benchmark, an LLM auditor reads the artifacts—which the tester cannot see—and labels each test. A test is valid if the facts it assumes hold in the initial state of the agent’s database, its messages lead the conversation to the situation it checks, and every behavior it expects of the agent follows from the artifacts or is necessarily implied by domain knowledge. A valid test that covers at least one boundary is a valid boundary test . It is explicitly valid if every expected behavior follows from the artifacts. The auditor counts the distinct explicit boundaries covered by the valid boundary tests, counting the two sides of each boundary separately.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AdaT 2 on four domains of τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench and compare it with AgentEval, which generates tests from the same discovery traces using the same generator model. Across the four domains, 74.3% to 88.3% of AdaT 2 ’s tests are valid boundary tests, and 62.7% to 83.3% are explicitly valid. The transformed tests add 13 to 46 explicit boundaries beyond those covered by the plain tests. In every domain, AdaT 2 produces a higher proportion of explicitly valid tests than AgentEval, and its test suite covers at least as many explicit boundaries and more sides. As regression tests, AdaT 2 ’s test suites detect all eight seeded faults in the airline domain and four of eight in the retail domain, whereas AgentEval’s test suites detect five and two, respectively.

paragraphs.en: In discovery, the tester runs a fixed number of sessions to learn which tasks the agent supports, what inputs they require, and how the agent responds to user requests. Each session has an objective (what the tester wants to learn in the session) and a strategy (how the tester pursues the objective through conversation). Before each session, an LLM planner chooses the objective and the strategy based on the traces of the earlier sessions. During the session, an LLM driver writes each user message, and the session ends when the driver decides that the objective is met or cannot be met, or when the session reaches the turn limit. The traces of these sessions, the discovery traces , are the input for test generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在探索阶段，测试者会运行固定数量的会话，以了解智能体支持哪些任务、需要哪些输入，以及智能体如何响应用户请求。 每个会话都有一个目标（测试者希望在该会话中了解的内容）和一个策略（测试者如何通过对话实现该目标）。 在每个会话开始前，一个 LLM 规划器会根据之前会话的记录选择目标和策略。 在会话期间，一个 LLM 驱动器会编写每条用户消息；当驱动器判断目标已达成或无法达成，或者会话达到轮次限制时，该会话即结束。 这些会话的记录，即探索记录，是测试生成的输入。

paragraphs.en: Following AgentEval, a test contains a goal , step hints , criteria , and a turn limit (Figure 4 , explained in Section 2.4 ). The goal names the behavior of the agent that the test exercises, and the step hints are the user messages that the tester sends in order. Success criteria describe the agent’s expected behavior, and failure criteria describe incorrect behavior the tester can observe.

paragraphs.en: A runner executes a test in a fresh session: it sends the step hints in order until it has sent all of them or the conversation reaches the turn limit, and it records the conversation as the execution trace . An LLM judge compares the execution trace with the goal and the criteria of the test and returns a verdict . The verdict is pass when the agent achieves the test goal, and the failure criteria do not hold. It fails when a failure criterion holds or when the agent clearly fails the goal and shows incorrect behavior that the tester can observe. Otherwise, the verdict is inconclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体在一个新会话中执行测试：它按顺序发送步骤提示，直到所有提示都发送完毕或对话达到轮次限制，并将该对话记录为执行轨迹。 一个 LLM 裁判将执行轨迹与测试的目标和标准进行比较，并返回一个判定结果。 如果智能体实现了测试目标且未触发失败标准，则判定结果为通过。 如果触发了某个失败标准，或者智能体明显未能达成目标并表现出测试者可以观察到的错误行为，则判定为失败。 否则，判定结果将是不确定。

paragraphs.en: In program testing, a boundary separates neighboring groups of inputs that a program handles or is specified to handle differently ( Clarke et al., 1982 ; Hierons, 2006 ) . The input of a conversational agent consists of the requests from the user. A boundary of an agent is a division of these requests into two groups, its sides , that the agent must handle differently. A condition of the agent’s policy defines a boundary: the requests that satisfy the condition lie on one side, and the requests that violate it lie on the other. Whether a request satisfies the condition can depend on the values in the request and on the state in which the user makes it, that is, on what the conversation has established and what the agent state contains. For example, the same request to raise the daily ATM limit of a debit card lies on different sides of the dashed boundary in Figure 1 before and after the agent has raised the limit within the last 24 hours. The policy specifies the behavior expected of the agent on one side of a boundary or on both sides. A boundary is explicit when the agent’s artifacts, that is, its prompt, the code of its tools, and the knowledge base that it consults, define its condition and the behavior expected on at least one of its sides.
paragraphs.zh: 在程序测试中，边界将程序处理或规定需以不同方式处理的相邻输入组分隔开来（Clarke 等，1982；Hierons，2006）。 对话智能体的输入由用户的请求组成。 智能体的边界是将这些请求划分为两个组（即其两侧）的一种划分，而智能体必须对这两侧采取不同的处理方式。 智能体策略中的某个条件会定义一个边界：满足该条件的请求位于一侧，违反该条件的请求则位于另一侧。 一个请求是否满足该条件可能取决于请求中的具体值以及用户提出请求时的状态，也就是说，取决于对话中已确立的内容和智能体当前状态所包含的信息。 例如，在智能体于过去24小时内提升过每日ATM限额之前和之后，同一“提高借记卡每日ATM限额”的请求会位于图1中虚线边界的不同两侧。 策略规定了智能体在边界一侧或两侧应遵循的预期行为。 当智能体的产物——即其提示、工具代码以及其查阅的知识库——定义了其条件以及在至少一侧的预期行为时，该边界就是明确的。

sents.en: For example, the same request to raise the daily ATM limit of a debit card lies on different sides of the dashed boundary in Figure 1 before and after the agent has raised the limit within the last 24 hours.
sents.zh: 例如，在智能体于过去24小时内提升过每日ATM限额之前和之后，同一“提高借记卡每日ATM限额”的请求会位于图1中虚线边界的不同两侧。

sents.en: The policy specifies the behavior expected of the agent on one side of a boundary or on both sides.
sents.zh: 策略规定了智能体在边界一侧或两侧应遵循的预期行为。

sents.en: A boundary is explicit when the agent’s artifacts, that is, its prompt, the code of its tools, and the knowledge base that it consults, define its condition and the behavior expected on at least one of its sides.
sents.zh: 当智能体的产物——即其提示、工具代码以及其查阅的知识库——定义了其条件以及在至少一侧的预期行为时，该边界就是明确的。

paragraphs.en: A boundary test sends the agent a request from one side of a boundary and checks whether the agent then shows the behavior expected on that side, and we say that the test covers this side of the boundary. A test with several criteria can cover several sides or boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 边界测试会向智能体发送来自边界一侧的请求，并检查该智能体是否随后表现出该侧预期的行为；我们称这种测试覆盖了边界的这一侧。 包含多个标准的测试可以覆盖多个侧面或边界。

paragraphs.en: We make three assumptions. First, the tester can reset the agent to a fresh session with the same initial agent state, a standard requirement of automated testing. Second, the testing budget is limited: every attempt to generate a test costs an LLM call, and a written test costs additional LLM calls to execute and judge, so the tester must cover many boundaries in a few attempts. Third, the agent complies with its policy in most conversations, so its faults are rare and its replies during discovery mostly show the expected behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们做出了三个假设。 首先，测试者可以将智能体重置为一个新的会话，同时保持相同的初始智能体状态，这是自动化测试的一项标准要求。 其次，测试预算有限：每次尝试生成测试都会消耗一次 LLM 调用，而书面测试则需要额外的 LLM 调用来执行和判断，因此测试者必须在有限的几次尝试中覆盖许多边界情况。 第三，智能体在大多数对话中都会遵守其策略，因此其故障很少发生，且在探索过程中其回复大多表现出预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: The running example of this paper is the airline agent of τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench ( Sierra Research, 2026 ) , which helps users book, change, and cancel flight reservations. The policy in the agent’s prompt requires that all flights of a reservation have the same cabin class. Figure 4 shows the boundary that this condition defines among the requests to change the cabin class of reservation NO6JO3, which has two unflown business-class flights. A request to change both flights to economy lies on the side where the agent can change the cabin class. A request to change only the first flight to economy lies on the other side, where the agent must not change the cabin class, and the test in Figure 4 covers this side.

paragraphs.en: For a plain test , the generator , an LLM, receives a statement alone. It writes at most one plain test for each of a fixed number of highest-ranked statements. The runner executes these tests, and the judge assigns each a verdict (Section 2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于普通测试，生成器（一种大型语言模型）仅接收一个陈述。 对于数量固定的排名最高的陈述，它最多为每个陈述编写一个普通测试。 执行器运行这些测试，而裁判则为每个测试分配一个判定结果（第 2.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: For a transformed test , the generator also receives a test transformation instruction from a predefined catalog. It writes transformed tests in a sequence of attempts , which we call test transformation (Figure 7 ). In each attempt, the selector chooses a statement–instruction pair by adaptive pair selection (Sections 3.3 and 3.4 ). The generator then either writes a transformed test for the pair or reports the pair as not applicable. The runner executes each transformed test immediately, and the judge assigns it a verdict. Before the next attempt, the selector updates what it has learned about the chosen instruction using the pair’s applicability and the judge’s verdict (dashed arrows). Test generation outputs the plain tests and the remaining transformed tests, each with its verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 对于经过转换的测试，生成器还会从预定义目录中接收一条测试转换指令。 它会按尝试序列编写转换后的测试，我们称之为测试转换（图7）。 在每次尝试中，选择器通过自适应对选择（第3.3节和第3.4节）来挑选一个语句–指令对。 随后，生成器会为该对编写一个转换后的测试，或报告该对不适用。 执行器会立即运行每个转换后的测试，而评判器则会给出判定结果。 在下次尝试之前，选择器会根据该对是否适用以及评判器的判定结果，更新其对所选指令的学习内容（虚线箭头）。 测试生成会输出普通测试和剩余的转换后测试，每个测试都附带其判定结果。

paragraphs.en: An LLM extracts statements from the discovery traces, one trace at a time. Because the agent complies with its policy in most conversations (third assumption, Section 2.3 ), the LLM can treat the behavior stated in the agent’s replies as the expected behavior. From each trace, the LLM writes a statement for each general combination of a condition and an observable behavior—such as a decision or an obligation—that an agent reply states in words. A reply that states several such combinations therefore yields several statements. The LLM phrases each statement for a class of entities, such as all reservations, instead of the one entity that a trace discusses. It leaves out values that do not affect the condition, such as the price of a booking. Each statement is stored with its supporting reply , the agent reply from which it was extracted. The generator receives each statement and its supporting reply as the target for its plain test and as the starting point for its transformed tests, which can cover other sides or other boundaries (Section 3.3 ). The statements extracted from all traces form the statement set ℋ \mathcal{H} .
paragraphs.zh: 一个大语言模型（LLM）每次从发现痕迹中提取一个陈述。 由于智能体在大多数对话中都遵守其策略（第三个假设，第 2.3 节），因此大语言模型可以将智能体回复中所述的行为视为预期行为。 对于每个痕迹，大语言模型会为条件与可观察行为的一般组合（例如决策或义务）编写一个陈述，这些组合由智能体的回复以文字形式表述。 因此，一个表述了多个此类组合的回复会产生多个陈述。 大语言模型会将每个陈述针对某一类实体进行表述，例如所有预订，而不是痕迹中讨论的单个实体。 它不会包含不影响条件的值，例如预订的价格。 每个陈述都会与其支撑性回复（即提取该陈述时所用的智能体回复）一同存储。 生成器会接收每个陈述及其支撑性回复，将其作为普通测试的目标，以及转换后测试的起点；这些转换后的测试可以覆盖其他方面或其他边界（第 3.3 节）。 从所有痕迹中提取的陈述共同构成了陈述集 ℋ \mathcal{H}。

paragraphs.en: A test transformation instruction k k , or simply instruction , changes one factor of a test, such as the wording of the user’s request, a value in that request, or the state of the conversation in which the user makes it. A pair ( h , k ) (h,k) combines a statement h ∈ ℋ h\in\mathcal{H} with an instruction k ∈ 𝒦 k\in\mathcal{K} , where 𝒦 \mathcal{K} is the set of instructions. To write the transformed test for a pair ( h , k ) (h,k) , the generator receives h h together with its supporting reply, the instruction k k , all discovery traces, and the tests most recently written in the run. The generator modifies only the step hints, as specified by the instruction; otherwise, it keeps the user request answered by h h ’s supporting reply and other relevant facts unchanged where possible.
paragraphs.zh: 一个测试转换指令 k k，或简称为指令，会改变测试的一个因素，例如用户请求的措辞、该请求中的某个值，或用户提出请求时对话的状态。 一个配对 ( h , k ) (h,k) 将一条陈述 h ∈ ℋ h\in\mathcal{H} 与一个指令 k ∈ 𝒦 k\in\mathcal{K} 组合在一起，其中 𝒦 \mathcal{K} 是指令的集合。 为了写出配对 ( h , k ) (h,k) 的转换测试，生成器会接收 h h 及其支持性回复、指令 k k、所有发现痕迹，以及本次运行中最近编写的测试。 生成器仅根据指令指定的内容修改步骤提示；除此之外，在可能的情况下，它会保持 h h 的支持性回复所回应的用户请求以及其他相关事实不变。

paragraphs.en: Pair selection aims to obtain, in a few attempts, valid boundary tests that cover many boundaries and sides. However, in our black-box setting, the tester cannot directly observe which tests are valid or which boundaries they cover. The selector , which chooses statement–instruction pairs, can therefore pursue validity and coverage only through proxies. A transformed test starts from the statement of its pair, and statements with similar text can describe the same boundary. To cover many boundaries, the selector therefore chooses the statement by the novelty order, which spreads the transformed tests over statements with dissimilar text. For the transformation instruction, the selector learns from two kinds of feedback that the tester observes after each attempt. The first is whether the generator finds the pair applicable, which helps the selector obtain tests in fewer attempts. The second is the judge’s verdict on the test, which serves as a proxy for its validity. In our evaluation, tests with a pass verdict are valid more often than tests with an inconclusive or fail verdict (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 配对选择旨在通过少量尝试，获得能够覆盖多个边界和边界的有效的边界测试。 然而，在我们的黑盒设置中，测试者无法直接观察到哪些测试是有效的，或者它们覆盖了哪些边界。 因此，负责选择语句-指令配对的智能体只能通过代理指标来追求有效性和覆盖率。 经过转换的测试从其配对的语句开始，而文本相似的语句可能描述相同的边界。 为了覆盖多个边界，该智能体因此按照新颖性顺序选择语句，从而将转换后的测试分散到文本差异较大的语句上。 对于转换指令，该智能体会从测试者在每次尝试后观察到的两种反馈中学习。 第一种是生成器是否认为该配对适用，这有助于智能体以更少的尝试获得测试。 第二种是评判者对测试的裁决，它作为测试有效性的代理指标。 在我们的评估中，通过裁决的测试比未定或失败裁决的测试更频繁地被认为是有效的（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Instructions differ widely in how often the generator finds their pairs applicable. Spreading the attempts evenly over the instructions would waste many attempts on those that the generator rarely finds applicable. To avoid this waste, the selector learns from earlier attempts which instructions to choose. Because an instruction alone cannot be used to generate a test and the selector tries each pair at most once, the selector learns about an instruction only from its pairs with other statements. We assume that the average outcomes of an instruction for earlier statements can guide the selector’s choices for later statements. However, the selector observes outcomes only for the chosen instruction, so within the few attempts of a run it must balance trying rarely chosen instructions against reusing those with good outcomes. This balance between exploration and exploitation characterizes the multi-armed bandit problem ( Lai and Robbins, 1985 ; Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020 ) , a sequence of choices among options, the arms , whose rewards are unknown in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 各指令在生成器判断其配对是否适用方面的频率差异很大。 若将尝试次数平均分配给所有指令，许多生成器极少判定为适用的指令将被浪费大量尝试。 为避免这种浪费，选择器会从早期尝试中学习应选用哪些指令。 由于单个指令无法单独用于生成测试，且选择器对每对组合最多只尝试一次，因此它只能通过该指令与其他语句的组合来了解其特性。 我们假设，某条指令在早期语句中的平均结果能够指导选择器对后续语句的选择。 然而，选择器只能观察到所选指令的结果，因此在每次运行的有限尝试中，它必须平衡尝试那些极少被选中的指令与重复使用效果良好的指令之间的关系。 这种探索与利用之间的权衡正是多臂老虎机问题（Lai and Robbins, 1985；Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020）的特征：该问题涉及在多个选项（即“手臂”）中进行一系列选择，而这些选项的奖励值是事先未知的。

paragraphs.en: During a run, the tester cannot tell whether a fail verdict reflects a fault in the agent, a defect in the test, or an error by the judge. The verdict reward is therefore a proxy rather than a measure of validity: it favors instructions whose tests receive a pass verdict, because the agent’s behavior matches the test’s expected behavior. This proxy has a cost: it assigns a lower reward to an instruction whose tests expose faults in the agent, and it relies on the third assumption (Section 2.3 ) to keep this cost small. The intermediate reward of 0.5 for an inconclusive verdict is a design choice that places this verdict between pass and fail.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AdaT 2 on four text-based domains from τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench ( Sierra Research, 2026 ) : the airline, retail, and telecom domains from τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) , and the banking domain from τ \tau -Knowledge ( Shi et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 τ 3 \tau^{3}-bench（Sierra Research，2026）的四个文本相关领域上对 AdaT 2 进行了评估：来自 τ 2 \tau^{2}-bench（Barres 等人，2026）的航空、零售和电信领域，以及来自 τ \tau-Knowledge（Shi 等人，2026）的银行业领域。

paragraphs.en: Across the four domains, how many of AdaT 2 ’s tests are valid boundary tests, how many explicit boundaries and sides do these tests cover, and how many additional explicit boundaries and sides do the transformed tests contribute?
paragraphs.zh: 在这四个领域中，AdaT 2 的测试中有多少个是有效的边界测试？这些测试涵盖了多少个显式边界和边？而经过转换的测试又贡献了多少个额外的显式边界和边？

paragraphs.en: In the airline and retail domains, how many attempts does adaptive pair selection need to write transformed tests, compared with other selectors, and how do the selectors compare in the validity of these tests and in the additional explicit boundaries and sides that they contribute?

paragraphs.en: AgentEval’s test suite in each domain consists of tests produced by our re-implementation of its boundary generation method ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , which uses the same discovery traces and generator model as AdaT 2 . For a fair comparison, we remove AgentEval’s limit on the number of tests, allowing it to generate one test for each node and edge of its workflow graph; our runner and judge replace AgentEval’s. We also implement a direct baseline to isolate the contribution of statements. Its generator receives all discovery traces, but no guidance from statements or instructions, and it is instructed to write boundary tests directly from the traces. It writes up to 150 boundary tests ( direct tests ) and stops early when it determines that the traces support no further tests.
paragraphs.zh: AgentEval 在每个领域的测试套件都由我们重新实现的边界生成方法（Lin et al., 2026）所产生的测试组成，该方法使用的发现轨迹和生成模型与 AdaT 2 相同。 为了进行公平比较，我们移除了 AgentEval 对测试数量的限制，允许其为工作流图中的每个节点和边生成一个测试；我们的运行器和裁判将取代 AgentEval 的对应组件。 我们还实现了一个直接基线模型，以分离各语句的贡献。 其生成器接收所有发现轨迹，但不会从任何语句或指令中获得指导，并且被要求直接从这些轨迹中编写边界测试。 它会编写最多 150 个边界测试（直接测试），并在判断轨迹无法支持更多测试时提前停止。

The static ranking keeps the novelty order but never updates the posteriors. Like AdaT 2 , the other six selectors learn from the outcomes of earlier attempts. Four of them keep the novelty order. Thompson sampling ( Thompson, 1933 ; Russo et al., 2018 ) replaces the two quantiles in the instruction score with one draw from each posterior. UCB1 ( Auer et al., 2002a ) , ε \varepsilon -greedy ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ) , and Exp3 ( Auer et al., 2002b ) choose the instruction using their own rules, without the reuse penalty. The other two choose the statement and instruction of a pair jointly: GP-BO uses Bayesian optimization with a Gaussian process ( Shahriari et al., 2016 ) , and the LLM selector asks GPT-6 Luna for an untried pair.

paragraphs.en: Following AgentEval ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , each execution of a valid boundary test receives a label that compares the judge’s verdict with the auditor’s judgment. Without seeing the verdict, the auditor judges whether the agent complied with what the artifacts or domain knowledge require for the behavior the test checks. For this judgment, it reads the execution trace, the agent’s tool calls, the changes made to the agent state, and the passages from the agent’s artifacts that support the test criteria. If the agent did not comply, the label is TP for a fail verdict and FN for a pass verdict. If the agent complied, the label is FP for a fail verdict and TN for a pass verdict. The label is INC instead of FP or TN when the execution ended before the agent was due to show the behavior that the test checks, or when a criterion demands more than what the artifacts or domain knowledge require. The label is also INC whenever the judge’s verdict is inconclusive. FP and FN thus expose errors of the judge, and INC exposes problems in the test generator or the runner. The false alarm rate is FAR = FP / ( FP + TN ) \mathrm{FAR}=\mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{TN}) , and the accuracy is ( TP + TN ) (\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{TN}) divided by the number of labeled executions, including those labeled INC.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 AgentEval（Lin 等人，2026），每次执行有效的边界测试都会获得一个标签，该标签将裁判的裁决与审计员的判断进行比较。 在未见裁决结果的情况下，审计员会判断智能体是否遵守了测试所检查的行为中，由产物或领域知识所要求的内容。 为了做出这一判断，审计员会读取执行轨迹、智能体的工具调用、对智能体状态所做的更改，以及支持测试标准的智能体产物中的相关段落。 如果智能体未遵守要求，则标签为：裁决失败时标记为 TP，裁决通过时标记为 FN。 如果智能体遵守了要求，则标签为：裁决失败时标记为 FP，裁决通过时标记为 TN。 当执行在智能体尚未表现出测试所检查的行为之前结束，或者当某个标准的要求超过了产物或领域知识所规定的内容时，标签将使用 INC 而非 FP 或 TN。 只要裁判的裁决无法确定，标签也将使用 INC。 因此，FP 和 FN 暴露了裁判的错误，而 INC 则揭示了测试生成器或执行器中的问题。 误报率（FAR）为 FAR = FP / ( FP + TN ) \mathrm{FAR}=\mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{TN})，而准确率为 ( TP + TN ) (\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{TN}) 除以已标记的执行总数，包括被标记为 INC 的执行。

paragraphs.en: In each domain, the runner executes every test from the suites of AdaT 2 and AgentEval once more on the original agent, and the judge assigns a new verdict to each execution. For these executions, the label follows the expert’s judgment, and the expert takes requirements only from the artifacts, not from domain knowledge. paragraphs.en: For RQ4, we built eight faulty agents in each of the airline and retail domains. Each faulty agent is a copy of the domain agent with one seeded fault: a policy flip that rewrites one policy passage to require different behavior. We defined the faults before running any test on the faulty agents. For each faulty agent, the runner executes each valid boundary test with an explicit mapping supported by the changed passage. The auditor labels these executions against the original agent’s artifacts, without knowing the fault. A test detects a fault when its execution on the original agent has a pass verdict, its execution on the faulty agent has a fail verdict, and the auditor labels the faulty execution TP and, when asked again with a description of the fault, attributes the fail verdict to the fault. A suite detects a fault when at least one of its tests detects it; its mutation score is the proportion of the eight faults in its domain that it detects. The expert also reviews every execution labeled TP on the faulty agents.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题4，我们在航空和零售领域各自构建了八个存在故障的智能体。 每个故障智能体都是领域智能体的副本，并植入一个预设故障：即策略翻转，将某一策略段落重写为要求不同的行为。 在针对这些故障智能体运行任何测试之前，我们都预先定义了这些故障。 对于每个故障智能体，执行器会针对每个有效的边界测试进行执行，并采用变更后的策略段落所支持的明确映射。 审计员会将这些执行结果与原始智能体的产物进行比对并标注，但并不知道具体的故障信息。 当一个测试在原始智能体上的执行结果为通过，而在故障智能体上的执行结果为失败，且审计员将故障执行标注为真阳性，并在再次询问故障描述时将该失败结果归因于该故障时，即表示该测试检测到了故障。 当一套测试中至少有一个测试检测到故障时，该测试套件即视为检测到故障；其变异分数等于该套件在其所属领域中检测到的故障数占八个故障总数的比例。 专家还会审查所有在故障智能体上被标注为真阳性的执行结果。

Our auditor agrees with the expert on more validity labels than the other two. paragraphs.en: The six other selectors that learn from earlier attempts perform about as well as AdaT 2 in validity and in the additional explicit boundaries and sides that their transformed tests contribute, with two exceptions: the LLM selector in the airline domain, whose transformed tests have a lower explicit validity rate and contribute fewer explicit boundaries; and GP-BO in the retail domain, whose transformed tests contribute fewer explicit boundaries and sides. AdaT 2 needs the fewest attempts, or about as few as the best of the other selectors. Its prior steers it to instructions that apply in most attempts, and its reuse penalty spreads transformed tests over several instructions. Uniform selection and Exp3 need the most additional attempts in both domains; the LLM selector needs more attempts in the airline domain; and UCB1 and Thompson sampling need more in the retail domain (Table 3 ). The transformed tests of the static ranking have a lower validity rate in the airline domain, and uniform selection contributes fewer explicit boundaries in both domains.

paragraphs.en: In all four domains, AdaT 2 ’s test suites have a higher explicit validity rate (Table 4 ); AgentEval’s test suites have a higher validity rate in the banking, retail, and telecom domains. In most of AgentEval’s valid boundary tests that are not explicitly valid, a criterion describes a general conversational behavior that the artifacts do not define. With more than three times as many tests, AdaT 2 ’s test suites cover more sides in every domain, with more explicit boundaries in the banking and telecom domains and about as many in the airline and retail domains. On the original agent, AdaT 2 ’s test suites have the lower false alarm rate in every domain, although in the airline domain the difference comes from a single execution. The expert confirms an agent fault in all 12 executions of AdaT 2 ’s tests that the auditor labels TP, compared with 6 of the 13 TP-labeled executions of AgentEval’s tests. A larger proportion of executions of AdaT 2 ’s tests is labeled INC, mostly because the judge returns inconclusive verdicts on plain tests. This is a weakness of AdaT 2 ’s test suites; as a result, they have lower accuracy in the banking, retail, and telecom domains. Compared with the direct tests, the plain tests are explicitly valid more often, but for equal numbers of tests, the direct tests cover as many or more explicit boundaries. However, the direct baseline stops early, after 126, 104, 83, and 96 tests in the airline, banking, retail, and telecom domains, respectively, when it finds that the traces support no further tests.

paragraphs.en: Because each run requires thousands of LLM calls, experiment costs limited us to three runs per configuration in RQ2 and one test suite per method and domain in RQ1, RQ3, and RQ4, which is too few for significance tests. In RQ2, however, the three runs of AdaT 2 vary little, with standard deviations of at most 2.6 attempts in N 50 N_{50} and 4.4 points in validity rates (Table 3 ), suggesting that a single run of AdaT 2 is representative. A test that exposes an agent fault receives a reward of 0, so the selector may choose that instruction less often. In our experiments, however, transformed tests account for 10 of the 12 executions on the original agent in which the expert confirms a fault. Our re-implementation of AgentEval may differ from the original, and our runner and judge may change the verdicts on its tests. Even without a test limit, AgentEval generates at most one test per node and edge of its workflow graph, so its smaller test suites are likely to cover fewer explicit boundaries and sides and detect fewer faults.

paragraphs.en: IntellAgent generates tests from the policies in an agent’s system prompt ( Levi and Kadar, 2025 ) , the Agent-Testing Agent analyzes the agent’s code ( Komoravolu and Mrini, 2026 ) , and SpecOps sets up the agent’s environment before each test ( Ahmed et al., 2026 ) . Sensei checks a chatbot’s conversations with an LLM user simulator against assertions written by human testers ( de Lara et al., 2026 ) . Tracer explores a chatbot as a black box and generates profiles of the simulated user’s goals and interaction style ( Sotillo del Horno et al., 2026 ) . AgentEval generates tests for the nodes and edges of a workflow graph mined from discovery traces ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . As in AgentEval, AdaT 2 ’s tester observes only user messages and agent replies and starts every session from the same initial agent state. AdaT 2 replaces AgentEval’s nodes and edges with extracted statements, so the generator receives the expected behavior directly rather than inferring it.
paragraphs.zh: IntellAgent 根据智能体系统提示中的策略生成测试（Levi 和 Kadar，2025），Agent-Testing Agent 分析该智能体的代码（Komoravolu 和 Mrini，2026），而 SpecOps 则在每次测试前设置智能体的环境（Ahmed 等，2026）。 Sensei 将聊天机器人与大型语言模型用户模拟器之间的对话，与人类测试人员编写的断言进行比对（de Lara 等，2026）。 Tracer 以黑盒方式探索聊天机器人，并生成模拟用户的目标和交互风格画像（Sotillo del Horno 等，2026）。 AgentEval 为从发现痕迹中挖掘出的工作流图的节点和边生成测试（Lin 等，2026）。 与 AgentEval 类似，AdaT 2 的测试者仅观察用户消息和智能体的回复，并且每次会话都从相同的初始智能体状态开始。 AdaT 2 用提取出的陈述替换了 AgentEval 中的节点和边，因此生成器可以直接获得预期行为，而无需进行推断。

paragraphs.en: In CheckList ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) , AdaTest ( Ribeiro and Lundberg, 2022 ) , and Weaver ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , human testers write, filter, or label expected test behaviors. Specification mining infers likely invariants ( Ernst et al., 2001 ) or state machines ( Ammons et al., 2002 ; Lorenzoli et al., 2008 ) from a program’s observed executions. AgentPex checks an agent’s traces against specifications extracted from the agent’s prompt ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) . Because the agent complies with its policy in most conversations (third assumption, Section 2.3 ), AdaT 2 extracts statements from the agent’s replies in the discovery traces and generates new tests from them. A statement is closer to a likely invariant than to a state machine because it describes a single condition and the behavior expected when that condition holds.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CheckList ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 )、AdaTest ( Ribeiro and Lundberg, 2022 ) 和 Weaver ( Yang et al., 2023 ) 中，人类测试员会编写、筛选或标注预期的测试行为。 规范挖掘会从程序的观察到的执行过程中推断出可能的不变量 ( Ernst et al., 2001 ) 或状态机 ( Ammons et al., 2002 ; Lorenzoli et al., 2008 )。 AgentPex 会将智能体的轨迹与从该智能体提示中提取的规范进行比对 ( Sharma et al., 2026 )。 由于智能体在大多数对话中都会遵守其策略（第三个假设，第 2.3 节），AdaT 2 会从发现轨迹中智能体的回复里提取语句，并据此生成新的测试用例。 与状态机相比，语句更接近于一个可能的不变量，因为它描述的是单个条件以及在该条件下预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: Domain testing ( White and Cohen, 1980 ; Clarke et al., 1982 ) and boundary value analysis ( Hierons, 2006 ) place tests near the boundaries between groups of inputs defined by a program’s code or specification. AutoBVA ( Dobslaw et al., 2023 ) and SETBVE ( Akbarova et al., 2026 ) detect black-box program boundaries from small distances between inputs and large distances between outputs. For the boundaries that AdaT 2 tests, two identical user requests (distance zero) can lie on different sides, because the side can also depend on what the conversation has established (Section 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 域测试（White 和 Cohen，1980；Clarke 等，1982）以及边界值分析（Hierons，2006）将测试用例置于程序代码或规范所定义的一组输入之间的边界附近。 AutoBVA（Dobslaw 等，2023）和 SETBVE（Akbarova 等，2026）通过检测输入之间的小距离以及输出之间的大距离来识别黑盒程序的边界。 对于 AdaT 2 所测试的边界，两个完全相同用户请求（距离为零）可能位于不同侧，因为该侧也可能取决于对话中已确立的内容（第 2.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: A statement resembles a test purpose, which specifies a set of tests in abstract terms ( Ledru et al., 2001 ) . The applicability condition of an instruction corresponds to the context of a test-selection pattern, which suggests tests for the risks in that context ( Howden, 2005 ) . Category-partition testing combines choices for categories of parameters and environment conditions, under constraints that human testers list in advance ( Ostrand and Balcer, 1988 ) . A pair combines one choice from each of two categories: statements and instructions. In place of such constraints, the generator decides whether the instruction applies to the statement and otherwise reports the pair as not applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 声明类似于测试目的，它以抽象术语指定一组测试（Ledru 等，2001）。 指令的适用性条件对应于测试选择模式的上下文，该模式会针对该上下文中的风险提出测试建议（Howden，2005）。 类别划分测试结合了参数类别和环境条件的选择，并受限于人类测试人员预先列出的约束条件（Ostrand 和 Balcer，1988）。 一个组合由两个类别中各选一项组成：声明和指令。 替代此类约束条件的是，生成器会判断该指令是否适用于该声明；否则，则报告该组合不适用。

paragraphs.en: Search-based testing guides test generation by a fitness function ( McMinn, 2004 ) , for example toward coverage targets in EvoSuite ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) and DynaMOSA ( Panichella et al., 2018 ) or toward inappropriate responses of LLM applications in STELLAR ( Sorokin et al., 2026 ) . The selector therefore learns from whether the generator writes a test and from the judge’s verdict, using a bandit whose arms are the instructions. paragraphs.en: We presented AdaT 2 , which extracts statements from an agent’s replies in discovery traces and uses them to guide boundary-test generation. In addition to plain tests for individual statements, AdaT 2 generates transformed tests from statement–instruction pairs. Because the number of possible pairs far exceeds the attempts available for a run, an adaptive selector prioritizes pairs that yield valid tests. Across the four τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench domains, AdaT 2 ’s test suites contain a higher proportion of explicitly valid boundary tests than those of AgentEval and a direct baseline. In every domain, transformed tests cover explicit boundaries that plain tests miss, and they account for most executions on the original agent in which an expert confirms a fault. As regression tests, AdaT 2 ’s test suites detect all seeded policy faults in the airline domain and half in the retail domain, outperforming both baselines. Future work includes generating tests for both sides of more explicit boundaries and reducing the judge’s inconclusive verdicts, which currently lower test-suite accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AdaT 2，它从发现痕迹中智能体的回复里提取陈述，并利用这些陈述来指导边界测试的生成。 除了针对单个陈述的普通测试外，AdaT 2 还会根据陈述与指令的组合生成转换后的测试。 由于可能的组合数量远超单次运行可尝试的次数，自适应选择器会优先选择能产生有效测试的组合。 在四个 τ 3 \tau^{3} -bench 领域内，AdaT 2 的测试套件中明确有效的边界测试比例高于 AgentEval 和直接基线方法。 在每个领域中，转换后的测试都覆盖了普通测试未能检测到的明确边界，并且占到了原始智能体上专家确认存在故障的大部分执行用例。 作为回归测试，AdaT 2 的测试套件在航空领域检测到了所有预设的策略故障，在零售领域也检测到了其中一半，表现优于两种基线方法。 未来的工作包括为更多明确边界的两端生成测试，并减少裁判给出的无法定论的判定，因为这类判定目前降低了测试套件的准确性。
